description: Delegate an implementation task to Kimi in an isolated git worktree. Kimi runs autonomously (--yolo) on a fresh branch, optionally looping against a test command. Returns a taskId; later 'collect' to grab the diff. Safe: changes are sandboxed, caller reviews & applies.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Bullet list of criteria the implementation must satisfy.

action.description: start: spawn delegated task; status: check progress; collect: stop + return diff + cleanup option.

autoTest.description: Shell command Kimi should run after editing to validate (e.g., "npm test"). If passed, Kimi is told to loop until it passes.

baseBranch.description: Branch/commit to base the worktree on (default: current HEAD of repo).

branchName.description: Name for the new branch in the worktree. Default: kimi/<random>.

cleanup.description: On collect: also run `git worktree remove` after grabbing the diff.

maxRalphIterations.description: Extra autonomous iterations (Ralph mode). Default 5 (use -1 for unlimited).

task.description: What Kimi should accomplish (required for action=start).

name: delegate-kimi
